QuestInfo.name: The Rememberer...
QuestInfo.1: I spoke with #p2020010#, who had a new suggestion to help me piece together this puzzle. She told me to go to see #b#p1061011##k in Sleepywood. I can sense the answers coming soon--they'd better, because my feet are tiring from all this walking! \n\n#t4161028#  #b#c4161028# / 1
QuestInfo.2: My journey continues...#p1061011# had no idea about the book. But he said he might be able to point me in the right direction to who would know about the book...

0.0: #p2022003# said that those alive don't know about this skill. Then you may want to find those who aren't alive. Go to #b#m105040300##k. Perhaps you will find your answers there.

yes.0: According to #p2022003#, some of the trainees from #m105040300# may know about this ultimate skill. #b#p1061011##k has been training for a long time. You can ask for help.

no.0: If you don't go, the clue of Bowman's ultimate skill will disappear and be lost to you...

1.0: Do you need to see me? The book...? Bowman's ultimate skill? I gather that's why you're here.

yes.0: Sadly, I have no idea about that. But I can find somebody who knows more.

npc.0: Don't you know #b#p1061011##k of #b#m105040300## ? He's busy with training, but will still speak with you. Don't hesitate to look for him. He's always appreciative of those handy with a Bow.

item.0: If you have nothing to say, don't disturb me!

lost.0: Luckily, netherworld spirits found your book lost. Please be more mindful of where you leave this.
